name: Icon Gallery
description: Download and use community-made icons in GD!

auto-unpack.name: Automatic unpacking
auto-unpack.description:
Icons you download from the gallery will be extracted and added right away in the designated icons folder.
***
When this is disabled, you will get an alert to chose to unpack the icon or not.

delete-zips.name: Delete ZIP Packs
delete-zips.description:
After an icon gets unpacked, the mod automatically deletes the ZIP package.
***
This allows you to disable that feature.

resources-folder.name: Use Resources Folder
resources-folder.description:
<cg>Vanilla Icons</c> downloaded from the Gallery will be extracted and replace icons from the main game.
***
<cr>Do not enable it</c> if you don't want to replace the original icons.

more-icons-folder.name: Use More Icons folder
more-icons-folder.description:
<cy>ALL</c> icons (includes Vanilla) downloaded from the gallery will be extracted and added in the More Icons folders.
***
Be aware you could overwrite existing ones.
more-icons-folder.enable-if-description: This option requires More Icons to be installed

icon-pack-folder.name: Icons Pack Folder
icon-pack-folder.description:
If none of the settings above are active, all the icons downloaded from the gallery will be extracted to a custom texture pack the mod creates at start-up.
***
You can also put a custom pack location to where the icons will end up too.
